description: Registry of available agent roles and their capabilities

orchestrator.description: Coordinates task execution, selects roles, manages workflow

planner.description: Analyzes requirements, decomposes into tasks, generates DAG
planner.activationCriteria: New project, new feature, major refactor

researcher.activationCriteria: Ambiguous technical decision, new technology evaluation

architect.description: Designs system architecture, defines patterns and contracts

implementer.description: Writes application code following established patterns
implementer.parallelizationNote: Backend and frontend can run in parallel when independent

verifier.description: Validates changes through testing and quality gates
verifier.activationCriteria: After implementation, before marking task complete

reviewer.description: Evaluates architecture, quality, security, and maintainability
reviewer.activationCriteria: Complex features, security-sensitive changes, architectural changes

debugger.description: Investigates and resolves errors, failures, and regressions
debugger.activationCriteria: Bug report, test failure, runtime error

deployer.description: Manages deployment, CI/CD, and infrastructure configuration
deployer.activationCriteria: Deployment preparation, CI/CD changes, infrastructure work

strategic-researcher.description: Performs 5D strategic intelligence: competitive landscape, UX trends, tech evaluation, and failure risks
strategic-researcher.activationCriteria: New product discovery, market research, or codebase onboarding

onboarder.description: Scans existing external codebases, extracts architecture, and embeds portable engineering DNA
onboarder.activationCriteria: Adopting, scanning, or importing an existing codebase

upgrader.description: Audits existing project DNA against modern industry evolutions and formulates upgrade plans
